summary.en: One morning, while having breakfast at the Café Poirot along with Kogoro and Ran, Conan notices a strange, glum-looking customer sitting at a table, eating ham sandwiches instead of the regular breakfast selection and without having consulted the menu, which indicates him as a regular client. What makes the guest so peculiar is that he has his eyes constantly fixed on Tooru Amuro while he is working. While discussing about the mysterious customer's real identity, Conan asks Rei about his status in the Black Organization, as well as the Public Security Bureau.
